mapper.insert: insert into xl_user_food_license (user_id, license_template_id, got_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{licenseTemplateId}, now(), now(), now())
mapper.select: select id, user_id, license_template_id, got_at from xl_user_food_license where id = #{id}
select id, user_id, license_template_id, got_at from xl_user_food_license where user_id = #{userId} order by got_at desc
mapper.update: update xl_user_food_license set user_id = #{userId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from xl_user_food_license ul join xl_food_license_template fl on ul.license_template_id = fl.id where ul.user_id = #{userId} and fl.destination_id = #{destinationId}
